CustomField.description: One plain label for reps and list views, derived from Decision, Send State, email status and the Relix case status.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, 'PASSED'), 'Verified', IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, 'NEEDS_REVIEW'), 'Needs review' & IF(ISBLANK(Review_Reason__c), '', ' - ' & Review_Reason__c), IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, 'REFUSED'), 'Identity refused', IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, 'EXPIRED'), 'Link expired', IF(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, 'SUPERSEDED'), 'Replaced by a newer link', IF(ISPICKVAL(Send_State__c, 'SENDING'), 'Sending', IF(ISPICKVAL(Send_State__c, 'SEND_FAILED'), 'Send failed', IF(ISPICKVAL(Send_State__c, 'SEND_UNCERTAIN'), 'Send uncertain - check the Relix Console', IF(Notification_Status__c = 'failed', 'Email failed', CASE(Relix_Status__c, 'STARTED', 'Link sent', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'Buyer in journey', 'SUBMITTED', 'Checking', 'PREPARING_RESULT', 'Checking', 'COMPLETED', 'Checking', 'REQUIRES_ATTENTION', 'Checking', 'Link sent'))))))))))
CustomField.label: Rep Status
